newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Chemopetrol 1996 profits dip.
newsitem.headline: Czech Chemopetrol 1996 profits dip.

text.p: Preliminary results showed on Friday that 1996 pre-tax profit of the Czech petrochemical conglomerate Chemopetrol a.s., fell to 1.52 billion crowns from 3.93 billion crowns in the previous year, the company said.
Press spokesman Jan Martinek told Reuters that the board would propose a net dividend on 1996 profit of 10 crowns per share, same as in 1995.
The fall in profit was mainly attributed to the loss in the company's refinery operations at the end of 1995 as part of a total restructuring and privatisation of the Czech petrochemical industry.
Total turnover fell to 16.9 billion crowns last year from 27.8 billion crowns in the final year of Chemopetrol's refinery operations.
Further results were not available, and all figures are still subject to an audit.
